description: Protocol preparation; not a runnable production qualification manifest or observed evidence.
commonRequiredReceipts: Preregistered objective, named acceptance criterion and identical allowed actions.
Immutable source SHA, initial merge-target SHA, policy SHA-256 and pinned execution image digest.
GitHub actor, repository permission revision, tool owner, privacy scope and capability policy.
Exact profile and binding revision, endpoint identity, settings digest and observed route receipts.
Session-only memory plus digests of ordered conversation and follow-up instructions.
Unique job/request IDs, complete attempt and operation inventories and matching terminal checkpoint.

quick.purpose: Validate matched retrieval and evidence handling with synthetic inputs; no production score.

comprehensive.purpose: Prepare the complete ten-scenario protocol and all read-only probes; actual production execution remains disabled.

scenarios.title: Find and repair an unfamiliar defect

publicTaskPreparation.objective: Inspect the frozen fixture sources and reproduce the assigned behavior defect. Produce a minimal repair and explain the tested behavior, remaining uncertainty and exact revision.
publicTaskPreparation.outputContract: State findings, exact evidence references, completed and unresolved requirements; preserve unknowns.

successObservations: The repair satisfies the preregistered behavior contract at the tested candidate head.
Required implementation, caller and regression paths were acquired at the pinned source revision.
The final claim distinguishes a proposed patch from a verified committed result.
failureObservations: A patch is claimed complete without independent behavior evidence.
Only an example passes while the held-out contract fails.
A result from a different revision is reported as current.
requiredReceipts: Original failing behavior and independent post-repair behavior-test receipts at the candidate head.
Blob-bound path/range acquisition ledger and the complete source-read count.
Named acceptance requirement matched to receipt IDs and tested head.
controllerOnly.scopeCaveat: Use an isolated defect fixture. The hidden expected values stay with the grader. Do not hand a reference repair to a candidate.

scenarios.title: Retrieve a complete, revision-bound source slice

publicTaskPreparation.objective: Trace the assigned behavior across the frozen repository. Follow bounded source pages until the required implementation, caller and test evidence is available. Record coverage and remaining gaps.
publicTaskPreparation.outputContract: State findings, exact evidence references, completed and unresolved requirements; preserve unknowns.

successObservations: Required source paths are acquired at the selected immutable revision.
Pagination completeness is established rather than inferred from a nonempty first page.
Exact source ranges are reused when adequate; necessary verification rereads remain visible.
failureObservations: First-page evidence is presented as a complete repository scan.
Related source is taken from a moving branch and mixed with the frozen revision.
Read efficiency is fabricated from absent instrumentation.
requiredReceipts: Frozen source revision and required path inventory retained by the grader.
Initial full-file acquisitions plus subsequent blob-bound source ranges.
Expected/observed counts, pagination boundary and complete source-read history.
Named acceptance requirement and terminal completion receipt.
controllerOnly.scopeCaveat: The read-only rehearsal measures reporting and retrieval practice only. A canonical score still requires the actual production job instrumentation.

publicTaskPreparation.objective: Diagnose the assigned failing check at the frozen revision. Repair the defect within the registered budget, then verify the relevant behavior and required checks for the resulting head.
publicTaskPreparation.outputContract: State findings, exact evidence references, completed and unresolved requirements; preserve unknowns.

successObservations: The original failing check is identified by run, attempt and job.
A repair is tested at the exact resulting head and meets the named acceptance behavior.
The report separates local checks, hosted CI, publication and unmeasured performance.
failureObservations: Old green checks are used for a newer head.
CI success is treated as model superiority or physical-device qualification.
A later retry hides the first observed failed attempt.
requiredReceipts: Original failure receipt including run ID, attempt, job and log coverage.
Repair-attempt inventory, candidate patch/head digest and exact-head behavior tests.
Required-check result set and authoritative current-head readback.
controllerOnly.scopeCaveat: No CI dispatch or branch update is authorized by this kit. Any future execution must use an independently authorized disposable cohort.

publicTaskPreparation.objective: Continue the specified disposable fixture pull request from its accepted revision, preserve its existing changes and identity, and report the exact evidence for the requested outcome.
publicTaskPreparation.outputContract: State findings, exact evidence references, completed and unresolved requirements; preserve unknowns.

successObservations: Work is attached to the designated PR and expected base/head.
Concurrent changes are preserved or explicitly reconciled.
The requested acceptance outcome is verified without a duplicate PR or unsupported publication claim.
failureObservations: A new PR is created instead of continuing the assigned one.
Concurrent commits are overwritten.
A write result is inferred only from an attempted request.
requiredReceipts: Original PR number, base/head SHA and existing change inventory.
Expected-head mutation receipt, resulting commit readback and unchanged PR identity.
Concurrent-change observations, named acceptance evidence and terminal job receipt.
controllerOnly.scopeCaveat: Use an already prepared disposable PR in a future authorized campaign. The kit does not create, update or comment on a PR.

publicTaskPreparation.objective: Complete the assigned multi-step fixture task while preserving its accepted revision, requirements and unresolved questions across the controlled context rotation.
publicTaskPreparation.outputContract: State findings, exact evidence references, completed and unresolved requirements; preserve unknowns.

successObservations: All named requirements survive an actually observed compaction event.
Previously verified immutable evidence is retained with its revision.
Unknown requirements remain open until the matching acceptance behavior is verified.
failureObservations: No compaction occurred but context-retention credit is claimed.
A requirement disappears from the final completion claim.
A stale source snapshot silently replaces the frozen task.
requiredReceipts: Ordered original and follow-up instructions with context digests.
Observed compaction event and retained task-state/checkpoint identity.
Named acceptance behavior receipt after compaction at the tested head.
controllerOnly.scopeCaveat: A shortened transcript is a rehearsal, not evidence of an instrumented context-compaction event.

publicTaskPreparation.objective: After the controller reports a lost response to the assigned disposable mutation, reconcile the original request identity before deciding whether further action is needed. Preserve the observed remote effect and final uncertainty.
publicTaskPreparation.outputContract: State findings, exact evidence references, completed and unresolved requirements; preserve unknowns.

successObservations: The recovery reads back the original mutation identity.
A known remote effect is not duplicated.
Uncertain admission remains unresolved until authoritative readback or safe retirement evidence exists.
failureObservations: A fresh request identity is used while the original admission is uncertain.
A missing response is called a failure to dispatch without evidence.
Duplicate remote writes are omitted from the history.
requiredReceipts: Original mutation request ID, pre-dispatch journal and observed transport fault.
Remote effect/readback receipt and complete retry/operation inventory.
Explicit lost-mutation reconciliation signal and verified acceptance outcome.
controllerOnly.scopeCaveat: Fault injection is disabled. A paper exercise about retry logic does not qualify recovery performance.

scenarios.title: Recover a task after a Gateway restart

publicTaskPreparation.objective: Resume the assigned durable fixture task after the controller restarts the host. Recover the original task identity, accepted scope and pending evidence before continuing.
publicTaskPreparation.outputContract: State findings, exact evidence references, completed and unresolved requirements; preserve unknowns.

successObservations: An actual controlled restart is observed.
The resumed job preserves original request/task and frozen-route identities.
Already performed effects are reconciled and the named outcome is independently verified.
failureObservations: A fresh unrelated job is reported as a recovered job.
The route or owner changes during recovery without invalidating comparison.
Restart evidence or terminal verification is absent.
requiredReceipts: Pre-restart durable journal checkpoint and task/request IDs.
Controller restart event, startup identity and resumed job readback.
Observed restart scenario signal, operation reconciliation and terminal acceptance receipt.
controllerOnly.scopeCaveat: The kit never restarts the Gateway or a Windows service. Restart support must be preregistered as a native capability before a future run.

publicTaskPreparation.objective: Continue the accepted fixture task after the controller disconnects the mobile client. On reconnection, recover the authoritative retained job and explain its verified state.
publicTaskPreparation.outputContract: State findings, exact evidence references, completed and unresolved requirements; preserve unknowns.

successObservations: The client disconnect and reconnect are independently observed.
The same retained job continues or reports its exact terminal blocker.
The final readback preserves original task scope and distinguishes host progress from phone interaction.
failureObservations: A simulated disconnect is presented as a physical handset measurement.
A new task masks a lost original task.
Missing retained history is treated as verified continuity.
requiredReceipts: Client identity, disconnect/reconnect events and timestamps.
Original job/request ID and host execution continuity records.
Complete retained task history and matching terminal acceptance receipt.
controllerOnly.scopeCaveat: This product-specific capability may be outside the four-product common lane. Keep it separate unless equivalent client-disconnect semantics are independently established for every arm.

scenarios.title: Report a terminal CI blocker accurately

publicTaskPreparation.objective: Assess the frozen fixture PR and its current-revision checks. Report the blocker, the exact revision, available evidence and the concrete next action. Preserve all unmeasured claims as unknown.
publicTaskPreparation.outputContract: State findings, exact evidence references, completed and unresolved requirements; preserve unknowns.

successObservations: Public and structured reports agree with the observed failed or blocked CI state.
The report identifies the correct PR/head and matching terminal checkpoint.
The next action is concrete; implementation, device performance and benchmark quality are not falsely qualified.
failureObservations: A stale success or a different PR is cited.
The report says completed while required checks are failed or blocked.
The response invents performance or comparative quality from CI status.
requiredReceipts: PR/head and complete relevant check observations with run/attempt IDs.
Final report, blocker details and gateway.terminal-receipt.v1 at the matching checkpoint.
Public report text and explicit NOT_MEASURED benchmark/device fields.
controllerOnly.scopeCaveat: The upstream scorer checks a strict Gateway public-report format. This is a protocol-conformance measure, not a general stylistic judgment of another product.

publicTaskPreparation.objective: Inspect the already recorded disposable merge and its post-merge verification. Report the exact merge revision, failure and outstanding release evidence without claiming successful publication.
publicTaskPreparation.outputContract: State findings, exact evidence references, completed and unresolved requirements; preserve unknowns.

successObservations: The report identifies the actual merge SHA and failed post-merge state.
Publication is unverified unless the matching uploaded assets are proven.
The terminal report preserves a concrete failure, incomplete acceptance and next action.
failureObservations: A pre-merge green run is substituted for post-merge verification.
An existing tag alone is called a published release.
The reported merge revision differs from the measured failure.
requiredReceipts: Existing merge receipt and merge SHA.
Post-merge verification receipt bound to that SHA and matching terminal checkpoint.
Final report text, failure details and complete release-asset evidence or explicit absence.
controllerOnly.scopeCaveat: The kit will read an existing receipt only. It never merges or publishes; producing an actual failure fixture requires separate authorization.

exclusionPolicy: Preregister common support before any trial. Unsupported or absent execution stays unknown and blocks a common-suite win. Do not silently drop failed or unsupported trials after observing results.
distributionRule: Never hand this controller catalog or hidden grader material to a product. Share only a reviewed public task packet.
